title: Port Sandwich language - Wikipedia
text: Port Sandwich, or Lamap, is an Oceanic language spoken in southeast Malekula, Vanuatu, on the eastern tip of the island. It was first described in 1979 by French linguist Jean-Michel Charpentier.

title: Port Sandwich Language (PSW) – L1 & L2 ... - Ethnologue
text: Port Sandwich is an endangered indigenous language of Vanuatu. It belongs to the Austronesian language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by the elderly only. It is not known to be taught in schools.
